ns2:course.label: Flat Pattern Drafting
ns2:course.description: Building on Introduction to Costume Patterning, Flat Pattern Drafting is focuses on mathematical drafting systems and paper manipulation to achieve the desired garment shape. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: THEA 442. Restricted to BFA/MFA students only or consent of instructor.
